method: Reference-guided built-in image_gen, one atlas per action; shared crop/scale; nearest-neighbor; fixed captions.

acceptance.basis: User accepted the 20-GIF set and requested Skill/gallery publication.

prompts.prompt:
Using supplied sprite as the EXACT character and pixel rendering reference, create ONE sprite animation atlas for ONE looping GIF. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen full-body consecutive poses, equal cells, generous transparent gutters, same scale and ground baseline, fixed central body axis. True crisp pixel art with deliberate square clusters and dark stepped outlines, limited colors, no smooth 3D/illustration shading, no anti-aliased blur. Preserve recognizable face, proportions, all costume pieces, colors, accessories throughout. Do not introduce props, text, numbers, gridlines, background or shadows. Action must involve head and torso plus relevant limbs and hair/cape/scarf/tail follow-through, not frozen body with isolated arm rotation. 16 distinct drawings: frame1 neutral, 2-4 gradually anticipate and begin action, 5-9 perform gesture with gentle evenly spaced transitions, 10-13 recover, 14-16 settle to near frame1 for seamless loop. Keep subtle facial anatomy consistent, hands simple pixel mitten shapes, limbs intact. Full body including ears/helmet/hair/feet always inside cell.
ACTION: shift weight, raise one hand into a clear thumbs-up, nod head and lean chest forward, then lower hand and settle
